subject: 15-min technical triage before demo — compatibility check for CartGlow
messages:
From: Sarah Li <sarah@cartglow.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 9 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Quick 15-min tech triage before full demo

Hi Ben (and Olga),

We just signed up for Redwood and our AM forwarded me to schedule a demo. Before the full product walkthrough, our eng lead asked for a very quick 15-minute technical compatibility check to confirm supported runtimes and integration patterns. We're on a tight cycle this month and want to make sure a full demo will focus on the right things.

High-level: CartGlow runs an in-house inference proxy (K8s, AWS EKS) and we use a mix of Open and managed models (mostly Mistral/LLMs). Not expecting deep ops questions — just need to confirm networking, authentication (KMS/HSM support), and whether prefix/KV caching will be viable for our use case.

Could someone do a 15-minute triage? Open windows tomorrow (Fri) morning PDT or Monday mid-day PT. If easier, send a short checklist of what you need and we'll reply.

Thanks,
Sarah
Sarah Li
Head of Product, CartGlow
---
CartGlow (https://cartglow.com)

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and congrats on signing up. Happy to run this.

I can do a 15-min triage tomorrow at 10:30am PDT or Monday 12:30pm PDT. If those don't work I can send a Calendly link. For the triage, it helps if you can confirm two quick items in advance so we can keep it tight:

- Primary model types (open weights vs. Redwood-hosted variants)
- Where inference traffic will originate (client-side app directly or server-side via EKS)

If Olga (solutions) can join, she'll cover caching and KMS questions — Olga, are you available for the 10:30am PDT slot tomorrow?

If it helps, I can also drop a 15-minute calendar invite after Sarah confirms.

—Ben

From: Sarah Li <sarah@cartglow.com>

Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jul 2026 08:01:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick 15-min tech triage before full demo

Thanks Ben — 10:30am PDT tomorrow works great for us. Confirming the two items:

- Primary model types: mix of open weights (Mistral family) and a couple of hosted variants for embeddings.
- Traffic: server-side via EKS, traffic originates from our Kubernetes nodes to outbound Redwood endpoints.

Also: we use AWS KMS for key management and have a transit proxy in front of the cluster for egress rules. Happy to share a one-pager during the call if helpful.

Link to our calendar block: https://cartglow.com/sarah/calendar/slot123

Look forward to the quick call.

—Sarah

Hi Sarah — thanks for confirming and for the details. 10:30am PDT tomorrow is on my calendar. I pulled together a two-page pre-demo checklist (attached) to speed the triage; no need to fill everything out but the items help me prioritize the 15 minutes.

Quick notes I'll plan to cover in the 15-min slot:
- Required network egress ranges and IP allowlist options
- KMS/HSM support and what we need for key import/policies
- Basic caching behavior (prefix/KV cache expectations) and how it affects latency/cost

If you can share the one-pager beforehand that would be great, otherwise we'll go live and capture any follow-ups. I'll send a calendar invite (attached .ics) and include a 1-line summary in the invite body to keep the meeting focused.
